title: Two dates on every Reference: original publication and ingestion
description:
Slice 3 of PPY-2e9064. Every Reference carries both dates where they can be found, every analysis states which it uses, and the UI and packs show both.

Fields already exist (amplify/data/resource.ts): createdAt = ingestion (always set); sourcePublishedAt = the source's publication date (set today only by web monitors and PDF resolution; HN, email, hand-added and imports leave it null). No schema change. Unknown publication date stays null: never copy createdAt into it.

Which analyses use which (design 2.3): ingestion date for the newsroom's own stream (acceptance/hub/cluster series, arrival baselines, learn_freshness, auto-accept latency); publication date for what the model may say ("published ...") , the resurfaced signal, concept trend reports and wiki timelines, and ordering inside a pack; both shown side by side.
Design: the design comment on the epic PPY-2e9064 (copied to docs/idea-context-packs.md by S1.0).
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
